protocol: At the usual first-view pace a model receives a maximum of two seconds per turn. Visual or acoustic changes can shorten these further. A captioner can hear a released two-to-ten-second phrase ending during a short turn even if the optional primary reader cannot name anything from that turn in isolation. Test preserving that phrase in sound_in_context with its own bounds and the time the current turn began. Keep current-turn-only sound_descriptions unchanged. No new sound labels, no new waveform analysis. Select the four shortest recordings among the 40 additional AVCaps films by frame count divided by native audio rate (tie by ID) so both independent readers can see each film in full at ordinary cadence. Present existing/full versus contextual report in separate fresh GPT sessions in alternating submission order (the two observers may run concurrently) at the default Reel pace, one observation per condition. No raw WAV or human caption given to GPT. Primary criterion for the interface is that valid earlier-context readings remain accessible with their original bounds whenever produced, without being marked current, suppressing silence and retaining the primary reader. Describe downstream accuracy on four films only as exploratory.
reader: Local signed-in gpt-6.1-terra, separate sessions, pictures and text. CoNeTTE with its default Clotho task, AST, YAMNet and local speech estimates in all conditions, optional Qwen3-Omni unavailable. Same original recordings, pictures, measurements and viewing times per film. The with condition also surfaces the just-completed cross-boundary waveform caption and an explicit note that a sound in that window may have stopped. Raw audio not attached to GPT.
rules: Only an available waveform caption ending during the current release qualifies. The current waveform must be nonzero. Prefer a wholly in-turn caption. Otherwise preserve any primary contextual reading or describe the last completed crossing window; in a tie use the shorter one. current_start_s divides already heard material from the current turn. No new classifier or source categories.
